subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 2: Team Talk – Watch out! It’s so cute!
outcomes: Follow a dialogue to find out what the animal is.
Use Watch out! / Wow! / It's so cute! correctly.
Explain why we shouldn't touch wild animals.

tf.s: The animal in the dialogue is a hedgehog.
tf.why: Yes, it has spines, small paws and whiskers.

tf.s: We say “Watch out!” to warn someone of danger.
It can't be a snake because it doesn't have scales.
Bears live in the place where the children are walking.
Emily thinks it could be a bird because she can hear birds.
Nawal wants to pick up the hedgehog.
tf.why: Yes, but Emily says they shouldn't touch it.

tf.s: Emily says they should touch the hedgehog because it is friendly.
tf.why: She says they shouldn't touch it because it may be scared.

tf.s: “It's so cute!” is a good reply to “Look at this baby rabbit!”
tf.why: We say it about small, lovely animals.

tf.s: Bayan hasn't seen any animals because there aren't any animals there.
tf.why: You have to look carefully and listen.

boxes.q: There's a scorpion near your foot! – ___
Look at this baby rabbit! – Wow! ___
boxes.why: We say it's so cute about lovely animals.

boxes.q: What is the animal in the dialogue?
It has no scales, so it can't be a ___.

boxes.why: Wild animals can be scared, so we look but don't touch.

boxes.q: Why does Emily think it could be a bird?
Who wants to pick up the hedgehog?
boxes.why: Nawal wants to pick it up.

boxes.q: What does the hedgehog have on its back?
Why can't it be a bear?
boxes.why: There are no bears in that place.
Use doesn't have for the negative.

hunt.q: Who wants to pick it up?

mcq.q: Which expression do you use to warn someone of danger?
Which body parts does the hedgehog have?
mcq.why: These clues show it is a hedgehog.

mcq.q: Why hasn't Bayan seen any animals yet?
o: You have to look carefully and listen.
mcq.why: Animals can be hard to see.

mcq.q: Which expression shows you are surprised and impressed?
Look at that turtle! It's huge! Which reply fits?
mcq.why: Wow! fits surprise at something huge.

mcq.q: A: Look! There's something in the grass. B: ___ It might be a snake.
mcq.why: A snake can be dangerous, so warn your friend.

mcq.q: Correct this sentence about the dialogue: The animal has wings.
mcq.why: Use doesn't have for the negative.

mcq.q: Why can't the animal be a snake?
Why does Emily say they shouldn't touch the hedgehog?
mcq.why: We shouldn't touch wild animals; they can get scared.

mcq.q: How do the children decide it is not a bird?
mcq.why: Birds have wings; this animal doesn't.
